models_evaluated: evidential deep learning ensembles (homogeneous and heterogeneous)

links.outcome: Segmentation Dice on external validation cohort versus internal test set
links.effect: External validation in 353 patients gave median Dice 0.92, versus 0.93 on the internal test set; no meaningful performance drop at the new site(s).
links.quote: External validation in 353 patients confirmed generalizability (median Dice 0.92), supporting safer clinical AI deployment and enabling calibrated uncertainty estimation for lesion segmentation beyond meningiomas.

unlisted_practices: Evidential deep learning ensembles to generate voxel-level aleatoric-like and epistemic-like uncertainty maps for segmentation
Calibrated credible intervals for tumor volume estimates

screen.reason: Evaluates an evidential deep learning ensemble for uncertainty quantification against neuroradiologist-identified ambiguous regions and volumetric calibration to improve safe clinical AI deployment.
